style: Recipe Nest Vault established warm-ivory ink-and-gouache cooking illustration: flat hand-drawn 2D objects, fine charcoal contours, restrained translucent colour washes, subtle handmade paper texture, sparse background, no photorealism. No people, no hands, no text, no labels, no logos, no watermark. Produce one clean landscape contact sheet with the specified grid; every panel is a separate useful cooking stage with clear cookware and ingredient state.

entries.prompt: Create a 3x3 landscape cooking-step sheet for feijoada. Panels in order: soaked black beans beside desalted carne seca; bacon, pork, beef and smoked sausage browning in a heavy pot; onion, garlic and bay leaves in rendered fat; beans and meats covered with water and orange wedges; gentle covered simmer with intact black beans; mashed beans stirred back to thicken the dark broth; bright sliced collard greens sautéing; complete plate with feijoada, white rice, collard greens, citrus and farofa. Leave the ninth panel empty as a quiet warm background tile. No text or people.

Leave the last two panels quiet and unoccupied. No text or people.
